description: Decision 131 operand probe (phase3.2_unreal-ue56-packed-preset item 2.10), Legacy, grid4x2, eight full-UV sets at 256 px. Every input is an authored Y/FLOAT OpenEXR (tools/parity/tier0_semantics/ao_operand_probe.py), never recorded pixels. Each set binds its own AO mesh map and has one AO fill in Normal, Nearest, identity UV, RepeatNone. s0: mesh 1.0, L32F channel at every 12-bit step j/4096 moved by -6..6 float32 steps, opacity 1. s1: the step values as the mesh, explicit Raw white L32F fill at opacity 1. s2: mesh float32(x/255), x = 1..254, times an L32F channel whose exact product sits nearest step + t ulp, t in [-3, 3] by half ulps; s3: the lattice on the channel and the partner in the mesh; s7: both off-lattice in [0.25, 1). s4: L16 at opacity 0.5, mesh 1.0, sources whose blend float32(S al) + float32(1 - al) (al the L16 code of 0.5, ties down) hits steps j/4096 >= 0.5 moved by -4..4; s5: L16 at opacity 1 with the s0 step values; s6: L32F at opacity 0.75 with sources whose fma(S - 1, 0.75, 1) hits steps >= 0.25 moved by -4..4. Unused texels hold 1.0. AO_Mixed, the AO channel and the AO mesh map are exported twice immediately as PNG 8 and twice as OpenEXR 32f, passthrough, no dithering; the recorder repeats all exports after Full save/close/reopen (r2). Check the template capture's AO formats and that the mesh and r1 channel exports equal the authored operands (the blends' formulas for s4 and s6) before interpreting AO_Mixed. No operator result is presumed.
